title: PINT: A Unified Model with Shared Predictive Intent for Robot Manipulation
title_zh: PINT：一种具有共享预测意图的统一机器人操控模型

paragraphs.en: Generalist robot manipulation can benefit from pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) for semantic reasoning and video generation models (VGMs) for world modeling. However, existing unified models that directly fuse them through shared attention at multiple layers can make it harder to draw on their specialized capabilities. We introduce PINT, a unified model that coordinates semantic reasoning, world modeling, and action generation through a shared chunk-level Predictive Intent while preserving expert-specific pathways. PINT inserts learnable Intent Tokens into the VLM sequence to form this representation, conditioning both the VGM and an Action Expert (AE). It replaces only the VGM’s prompt conditioning and retains the VGM at inference, where the AE reads its representations through one-way attention. Rather than prescribing what Predictive Intent should encode, PINT learns it jointly from the native prediction objectives of the VLM, VGM, and AE, which provide complementary views of the same upcoming task execution. Training uses two stages: Stage 1 freezes the VGM so that future video prediction shapes Predictive Intent with task-relevant future dynamics, while Stage 2 fixes the learned Intent and adapts the VGM and AE. Without embodied pretraining, PINT achieves strong in-distribution (ID) performance and substantially improves out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization, reaching 15.5% on RoboTwin 2.0-Hard compared with 1.8% for Fast-WAM and 3.2% for StarVLA, and 79.5% on LIBERO-Plus compared with 51.5% and 75.0%, respectively. Across five real-world bimanual tasks, PINT reaches 68% ID and 24% OOD success, compared with 35%/9% for pretrained Motus and 67%/35% for pretrained π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} .
paragraphs.zh: 通用型机器人操作可以从预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLM）中受益于语义推理能力，并从视频生成模型（VGM）中受益于世界建模能力。 然而，现有的统一模型通过多层共享注意力直接融合这些模型，反而可能使它们难以有效利用各自的专业能力。 我们提出了 PINT，一种统一模型，它通过共享的块级预测意图（Predictive Intent）来协调语义推理、世界建模和行动生成，同时保留各专家模块的专用路径。 PINT 将可学习的意图标记（Intent Tokens）插入到 VLM 序列中形成这种表示，从而对 VGM 和行动专家（AE）施加条件约束。 该模型仅替换 VGM 的提示条件部分，在推理阶段仍保留完整的 VGM，此时 AE 通过单向注意力读取其表示。 PINT 并未预先规定预测意图应编码的内容，而是从 VLM、VGM 和 AE 各自的原始预测目标中联合学习这种意图，这些目标为同一待执行任务提供了互补的视角。 训练分为两个阶段：第一阶段冻结 VGM，使未来视频预测能够用与任务相关的动态信息塑造预测意图；第二阶段则固定已学习的意图，并对 VGM 和 AE 进行适配。 在没有具身预训练的情况下，PINT 在分布内（ID）任务上实现了强劲的性能，并显著提升了分布外（OOD）泛化能力：在 RoboTwin 2.0-Hard 数据集上达到 15.5%，而 Fast-WAM 和 StarVLA 分别为 1.8% 和 3.2%；在 LIBERO-Plus 数据集上达到 79.5%，而另外两个模型分别为 51.5% 和 75.0%。 在五个真实世界的双手操作任务中，PINT 的 ID 成功率为 68%，OOD 成功率为 24%，而预训练的 Motus 模型仅为 35%/9%，预训练的 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 模型则为 67%/35%。

paragraphs.en: Generalist robot manipulation requires understanding and interacting with complex physical environments across diverse tasks. Leveraging the semantic knowledge and reasoning capabilities of pretrained vision-language models (VLMs), Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models translate visual and linguistic understanding into robot actions [ 3 , 4 , 5 ] . Yet standard VLAs do not explicitly model future physical dynamics. In parallel, large-scale video pretraining equips video generation models (VGMs) with strong priors over physical dynamics [ 6 ] . Recent World-Action Models (WAMs) [ 7 , 8 ] leverage these priors for future video prediction and action generation, but typically do not exploit the semantic reasoning of VLMs. Together, these advances motivate unified models that integrate semantic reasoning, world modeling, and action generation. This raises a central challenge: how to effectively combine the complementary capabilities of pretrained VLMs and VGMs.
paragraphs.zh: 通用型机器人操作需要理解并应对多样化任务中的复杂物理环境。 通过利用预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）的语义知识和推理能力，视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能够将视觉和语言理解转化为机器人动作 [ 3 , 4 , 5 ] 。 然而，标准的 VLA 并未显式建模未来的物理动态。 与此同时，大规模视频预训练使视频生成模型（VGM）具备了对物理动态的强先验知识 [ 6 ] 。 近期的世界-动作模型（WAM）[ 7 , 8 ] 利用这些先验知识进行未来视频预测和动作生成，但通常并未利用 VLM 的语义推理能力。 这些进展共同推动了集成语义推理、世界建模和动作生成的统一模型的发展。 这引出了一个核心挑战：如何有效结合预训练 VLM 和 VGM 的互补能力。

paragraphs.en: Recent unified models often directly fuse vision-language, video, and action representations through shared attention at multiple layers [ 1 , 9 ] . Yet pretrained VLMs and VGMs acquire their capabilities through different architectures, conditioning schemes, and learning objectives. These differences lead to specialized internal representations. Direct fusion forces these representations to serve both expert-specific computation and cross-expert coordination, which can make it harder to draw on each pretrained expert’s specialized capabilities. Several methods instead preserve selected pretrained components or introduce structured interaction pathways [ 10 , 11 ] . These approaches highlight a core tension between expert integration and specialization. The key question is what to share for coordination and what to preserve for specialization.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的统一模型通常通过多层共享注意力机制，直接融合视觉-语言、视频和行动表示 [ 1 , 9 ] 。 然而，预训练的 VLMs 和 VGMs 是通过不同的架构、条件化方案和学习目标获得其能力的。 这些差异导致了专门的内部表示。 直接融合迫使这些表示同时服务于专家特定的计算和跨专家的协调，这可能会使利用每个预训练专家的专门能力变得更加困难。 一些方法则选择保留特定的预训练组件，或引入结构化的交互路径 [ 10 , 11 ] 。 这些方法凸显了专家整合与专业化之间的核心矛盾。 关键问题是：哪些内容应共享以实现协调，哪些内容应保留以实现专业化。

paragraphs.en: To this end, we propose PINT (Fig. PINT: A Unified Model with Shared Predictive Intent for Robot Manipulation ), a unified model that coordinates semantic reasoning, world modeling, and action generation through a shared Predictive Intent while preserving expert-specific pathways. Predictive Intent is a compact, chunk-level representation of the upcoming task execution. PINT inserts learnable Intent Tokens into the VLM sequence to form this representation, which conditions both the VGM and the Action Expert (AE). PINT replaces only the VGM’s prompt conditioning, preserving its pretrained generative pathway, and retains the VGM at inference, where the AE reads its representations through one-way attention. Rather than prescribing what Predictive Intent should encode, PINT learns it jointly from the native prediction objectives of the VLM, VGM, and AE, which provide complementary views of the same upcoming task execution. To facilitate learning of Predictive Intent, PINT adopts a two-stage training strategy: Stage 1 freezes the VGM, forcing future video optimization to rely on the Predictive Intent and shaping it with task-relevant future dynamics. Stage 2 then freezes the VLM and Intent Tokens while adapting the VGM and AE to refine video and action generation.

The VGM remains active at inference so that the AE can draw on its representations through one-way attention, while a two-stage strategy lets future video supervision shape Predictive Intent with the VGM frozen before adapting the VGM and AE.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 PINT，它通过可学习的意图标记（Intent Tokens）实现预测性意图（Predictive Intent），这些意图标记同时对 VGM 和 AE 施加条件约束，并且仅替换 VGM 的提示条件部分，从而保留其预训练的生成路径。 在推理阶段，VGM 保持活跃状态，以便 AE 能够通过单向注意力机制利用其表示；同时，一种两阶段策略允许未来的视频监督在冻结 VGM 的情况下塑造预测性意图，然后再对 VGM 和 AE 进行适配。

paragraphs.en: VLA models adapt pretrained VLMs for robot action generation. RT-2 transfers web-scale vision-language knowledge to robotic control through action tokenization [ 3 ] , while OpenVLA scales this paradigm to diverse robot demonstrations [ 4 ] . Later work improves continuous action generation with π 0 \pi_{0} [ 5 ] , action tokenization with FAST [ 15 ] , and open-world generalization with π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} [ 2 ] . Recent extensions further improve downstream adaptation, temporal memory, and contact-rich manipulation [ 16 , 17 , 18 ] . Several VLA approaches introduce explicit future supervision, including future image goals in CoT-VLA, future prediction in UP-VLA, and world knowledge forecasting in DreamVLA [ 19 , 20 , 21 ] .
paragraphs.zh: VLA 模型将预训练的 VLM 应用于机器人动作生成。 RT-2 通过动作分词将网络规模的视觉语言知识迁移到机器人控制中 [3]，而 OpenVLA 则将这一范式扩展到了多样化的机器人演示中 [4]。 后续研究通过 π₀ \pi_{0} [5] 改进了连续动作生成，通过 FAST [15] 改进了动作分词，并通过 π₀.₅ \pi_{0.5} [2] 实现了开放世界的泛化能力。 近期的扩展进一步提升了下游任务的适应能力、时序记忆能力以及富含接触操作的操控能力 [16, 17, 18]。 多种 VLA 方法引入了显式的未来监督，包括 CoT-VLA 中的未来图像目标、UP-VLA 中的未来预测，以及 DreamVLA 中的世界知识预测 [19, 20, 21]。

paragraphs.en: A complementary line more directly couples future visual prediction with action generation. paragraphs.zh: 一条互补的线路更直接地将未来视觉预测与动作生成耦合起来。 GR-1 和 GR-2 共同对未来的视觉观察和机器人动作进行建模，并利用大规模视频生成预训练来实现操控 [ 22 , 23 ] 。 近期的 WAMs 通过 WorldVLA [ 24 ] 中的统一图像与动作生成、DreamZero [ 7 ] 中的预训练视频扩散，以及 Fast-WAM [ 8 ] 中在推理时无需未来去噪的训练阶段视频建模，进一步拓展了这一方向。

paragraphs.en: A complementary line routes future information through compact representations. World Tokens maps VLM features into tokens that condition both video prediction and action generation [ 11 ] , while InternVLA-A1.5 learns foresight tokens in an auxiliary expert that shares attention layers with the VLM and replaces the text conditioning of a frozen pretrained VGM [ 10 ] . Both remove the video branch at inference [ 11 , 10 ] . WLA-0 conditions its world expert with meta-queries [ 28 ] , DIAL defines intent as latent visual foresight [ 29 ] , and LAWA represents future intention through compact latent actions [ 30 ] . Other methods represent future evolution through latent queries, visual subgoals, or structured world representations [ 31 , 32 , 33 , 34 ] . Compared with World Tokens and InternVLA-A1.5, PINT forms Predictive Intent directly within the VLM sequence, without an external adapter or an auxiliary expert sharing attention with the VLM [ 11 , 10 ] . PINT first learns Predictive Intent with the VGM frozen, then fixes the learned Intent and adapts the VGM, which remains active at inference and provides representations to the AE through one-way attention.
paragraphs.zh: 一条互补线路通过紧凑表示传递未来信息。 World Tokens 将 VLM 特征映射为既能条件视频预测又能条件动作生成的标记 [ 11 ]，而 InternVLA-A1.5 则在一个辅助专家中学习远见标记，该专家与 VLM 共享注意力层，并替换了冻结预训练 VGM 的文本条件输入 [ 10 ]。 两者在推理时都移除了视频分支 [ 11 , 10 ]。 WLA-0 通过元查询为其世界专家提供条件 [ 28 ]，DIAL 将意图定义为潜在的视觉远见 [ 29 ]，而 LAWA 则通过紧凑的潜在动作表示未来意图 [ 30 ]。 其他方法通过潜在查询、视觉子目标或结构化世界表示来表现未来的演化过程 [ 31 , 32 , 33 , 34 ]。 与 World Tokens 和 InternVLA-A1.5 相比，PINT 直接在 VLM 序列内部形成预测意图，无需外部适配器或与 VLM 共享注意力的辅助专家 [ 11 , 10 ]。 PINT 首先在冻结 VGM 的情况下学习预测意图，然后固定所学到的意图并对 VGM 进行适配；VGM 在推理时保持活跃，并通过单向注意力为 AE 提供表示。

paragraphs.en: We use Qwen3.5-4B [ 42 ] and Wan2.2-5B [ 6 ] as the VLM and VGM backbones. PINT conditions the AE on layer-wise current-frame VGM features, while PINT-VA extends conditioning to all video latents and synchronously denoises future video and action latents at inference. On a single NVIDIA A100 80GB GPU (BF16, batch size 1), end-to-end generation of a 32-step action chunk with 10 denoising steps takes 266, 331, and 776 ms for Fast-WAM, PINT, and PINT-VA, respectively. PINT therefore incurs only moderate additional latency over Fast-WAM, while PINT-VA trades substantially higher inference cost for stronger performance. Additional implementation, evaluation, and latency details are provided in Appendices A , B , and D.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 Qwen3.5-4B [ 42 ] 和 Wan2.2-5B [ 6 ] 分别用作 VLM 和 VGM 的基础模型。 PINT 基于逐层当前帧的 VGM 特征对 AE 进行条件约束，而 PINT-VA 则将条件约束扩展至所有视频潜在变量，并在推理时同步消除未来视频和行动潜在变量的噪声。 在单块 NVIDIA A100 80GB GPU（BF16，批量大小为 1）上，生成一个包含 10 次去噪步骤的 32 步动作片段，Fast-WAM、PINT 和 PINT-VA 的端到端生成时间分别为 266、331 和 776 毫秒。 因此，PINT 相比 Fast-WAM 仅带来中等程度的额外延迟，而 PINT-VA 则以显著更高的推理成本换取更强的性能。 更多实现、评估和延迟细节见附录 A、B 和 D.3。

sents.en: PINT therefore incurs only moderate additional latency over Fast-WAM, while PINT-VA trades substantially higher inference cost for stronger performance.
sents.zh: 因此，PINT 相比 Fast-WAM 仅带来中等程度的额外延迟，而 PINT-VA 则以显著更高的推理成本换取更强的性能。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate PINT on LIBERO [ 50 ] , LIBERO-Plus [ 14 ] , RoboTwin 2.0 [ 12 ] , and five real-world manipulation tasks. For RoboTwin 2.0, we train on all 50 tasks using the official clean demonstrations and evaluate Easy and Hard as ID and OOD settings, respectively. For real-world experiments, we evaluate ID and OOD conditions, with OOD jointly varying lighting, background, and object location.

paragraphs.en: We compare PINT with representative VLA, WAM, and unified-model baselines. Embodied pretraining provides additional robot experience and can improve downstream performance and generalization, particularly under distribution shift [ 2 , 45 ] . We therefore group methods by embodied pretraining. Methods without embodied pretraining serve as our primary comparison, while embodied-pretrained methods provide strong references. We highlight Fast-WAM [ 8 ] , StarVLA [ 13 ] , and Motus [ 1 ] as representative baselines for WAMs, VLAs, and unified models with direct fusion, respectively. Fast-WAM uses the same Wan2.2-5B VGM as PINT, StarVLA uses a Qwen-family VLM, and Motus uses both a Qwen-family VLM and the same VGM, together with embodied pretraining (result provenance in Appendix C ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 PINT 与具有代表性的 VLA、WAM 和统一模型基线方法进行比较。 具身预训练可提供额外的机器人经验，并能提升下游任务的性能和泛化能力，尤其是在分布发生偏移的情况下 [ 2 , 45 ] 。 因此，我们根据是否进行具身预训练对方法进行分类。 未进行具身预训练的方法作为我们的主要对比对象，而经过具身预训练的方法则提供了强有力的参考。 我们将 Fast-WAM [ 8 ]、StarVLA [ 13 ] 和 Motus [ 1 ] 分别作为 WAM、VLA 以及直接融合统一模型的典型基线方法。 Fast-WAM 使用与 PINT 相同的 Wan2.2-5B VGM，StarVLA 使用 Qwen 系列的 VLM，而 Motus 则同时使用 Qwen 系列的 VLM 和相同的 VGM，并辅以具身预训练（结果来源见附录 C）。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 1 , PINT achieves 98.0% average success on LIBERO and 79.5% on LIBERO-Plus without embodied pretraining. On LIBERO-Plus, PINT substantially outperforms Fast-WAM (51.5%) and surpasses StarVLA-OFT (75.0%) and ResVLA (75.3%), the strongest baseline without embodied pretraining. It also exceeds several embodied-pretrained methods, including Motus (76.0%) and MemoryVLA++ (73.1%). PINT-VA further improves the averages to 98.2% on LIBERO and 81.0% on LIBERO-Plus.

paragraphs.en: We introduced PINT, which coordinates semantic reasoning, world modeling, and action generation through a shared chunk-level Predictive Intent while preserving expert-specific pathways. PINT learns this Intent from the native prediction objectives of the VLM, VGM, and AE through a two-stage strategy that first shapes it with a frozen pretrained VGM and then adapts the VGM and AE. Across simulation and real-world manipulation, PINT achieves strong ID performance and improved OOD generalization without embodied pretraining. These results suggest that a compact shared predictive interface can coordinate specialized pretrained models for robot manipulation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 PINT，它通过一个共享的块级预测意图（Predictive Intent）来协调语义推理、世界建模和行动生成，同时保留了各专家模型特有的处理路径。 PINT 通过一种两阶段策略，从 VLM、VGM 和 AE 的原始预测目标中学习这种意图：首先使用一个冻结的预训练 VGM 塑造该意图，然后对 VGM 和 AE 进行适配。 在模拟环境和真实世界操作任务中，PINT 无需具身预训练即可实现强大的 ID 性能，并提升了 OOD 泛化能力。 这些结果表明，一个紧凑的共享预测接口能够协调多个经过专门预训练的模型，以完成机器人操作任务。

sents.zh: 在模拟环境和真实世界操作任务中，PINT 无需具身预训练即可实现强大的 ID 性能，并提升了 OOD 泛化能力。

sents.en: These results suggest that a compact shared predictive interface can coordinate specialized pretrained models for robot manipulation.
sents.zh: 这些结果表明，一个紧凑的共享预测接口能够协调多个经过专门预训练的模型，以完成机器人操作任务。

paragraphs.en: Our evaluation focuses on robot manipulation and a single pairing of VLM and VGM backbones. Combining PINT with embodied pretraining and extending it to broader embodied settings and larger-scale training remain future work.

paragraphs.en: The VLM receives each camera view as an independent image, together with the task instruction and the current robot state discretized as text. The 32 Intent Tokens are appended to the multimodal prefix, followed by the training-only autoregressive action suffix. At inference, the autoregressive suffix is omitted. paragraphs.zh: VLM 将每个摄像头视角作为独立的图像接收，同时接收任务指令以及以文本形式离散化的当前机器人状态。 32 个意图令牌被附加到多模态前缀之后，接着是仅用于训练的自回归动作后缀。 在推理阶段，自回归后缀会被省略。 因此，PINT 通过单次 VLM 前缀前向传播提取预测意图，而不会自回归地生成动作令牌或中间推理轨迹。

paragraphs.en: Default PINT first performs a VLM forward pass to obtain Predictive Intent. The composed current frame is then encoded by the pretrained video VAE, and the VGM performs a single forward pass conditioned on Predictive Intent. The resulting layer-wise current-frame K/V representations are cached and reused throughout action generation. The AE generates the 32-step action chunk using 10 explicit-Euler denoising steps with the shifted flow-time schedule used in our implementation ( shift = 5 \mathrm{shift}=5 ), after which the predicted actions are mapped back to the original action space. Default PINT does not denoise future-video latents at inference.
paragraphs.zh: Default PINT 首先执行一次 VLM 前向传播，以获得预测意图。 随后，合成的当前帧由预训练的视频 VAE 进行编码，而 VGM 则基于预测意图执行一次前向传播。 由此得到的逐层当前帧 K/V 表示会被缓存，并在整个动作生成过程中重复使用。 AE 使用 10 次显式欧拉降噪步骤，结合我们实现中使用的偏移流时间调度（shift = 5 \mathrm{shift}=5），生成包含 32 步的动作片段；之后，预测的动作会被映射回原始动作空间。 Default PINT 在推理阶段不会对未来视频的潜在变量进行降噪。

paragraphs.en: PINT-VA uses the same model components and keeps Stage 1 unchanged. During Stage 2 and inference, the AE additionally accesses layer-wise VGM features from all video latents. The nine-frame video sequence is temporally compressed by the Wan VAE into three latent time positions, consisting of one current-frame position and two future positions, each with its own spatial latent grid. The current-frame latent remains fixed, while future-video and action latents are synchronously updated using the same 10-step shifted flow-time schedule. Future-video latents are not decoded back to RGB during standard action inference.
paragraphs.zh: PINT-VA 使用相同的模型组件，并保持第一阶段不变。 在第二阶段和推理过程中，自编码器还会访问所有视频潜在表示中的逐层 VGM 特征。 九帧的视频序列通过 Wan VAE 在时间上被压缩为三个潜在时间位置，包括一个当前帧位置和两个未来位置，每个位置都有各自的空间潜在网格。 当前帧的潜在表示保持固定，而未来视频和动作的潜在表示则使用相同的 10 步移位流时间调度同步更新。 在标准的动作推理过程中，未来视频的潜在表示不会被解码回 RGB 格式。

paragraphs.en: The autoregressive loss is averaged over valid supervised tokens. The action and video objectives are averaged over valid action elements and future-video latent elements, respectively, and use the timestep-dependent weighting of the flow scheduler. paragraphs.en: Stage 1 initializes the VLM from Qwen3.5-4B and the VGM and video VAE from Wan2.2-TI2V-5B. Following Fast-WAM, the AE backbone is initialized by copying or interpolating weights from the pretrained Wan DiT, while newly introduced components, including the action encoder, state encoder, and output head, are initialized separately. The two Intent projectors are randomly initialized. The 32 Intent Token embeddings are initialized with the mean of the original Qwen vocabulary embeddings and are subsequently optimized as independent learnable tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 1 从 Qwen3.5-4B 初始化 VLM，并从 Wan2.2-TI2V-5B 初始化 VGM 和视频 VAE。 遵循 Fast-WAM 方法，AE 主干网络通过复制或插值预训练的 Wan DiT 的权重进行初始化，而新引入的组件（包括动作编码器、状态编码器和输出头）则分别进行初始化。 两个意图投影器采用随机初始化。 32 个意图令牌嵌入以原始 Qwen 词汇表嵌入的均值进行初始化，随后作为独立的可学习令牌进行优化。

paragraphs.en: During Stage 1, the VGM DiT and video VAE are frozen, while the VLM, Intent Tokens, AE, and both Intent projectors are optimized jointly. Stage 2 is initialized from the final Stage 1 checkpoint without reinitializing the AE or projectors. The VLM, Intent Tokens, and video VAE are then frozen, while the VGM DiT, AE, and both Intent projectors remain trainable. The autoregressive branch is not executed during Stage 2. As described in Appendix A.2 , the final Stage 2 checkpoint is used for evaluation.

The AE continues to use Predictive Intent together with proprioceptive state, and the 32 Intent Tokens remain otherwise unchanged. The Intent-to-VGM projector is bypassed for VGM conditioning. Under the causal VLM mask, the AE-specific Intent Tokens can attend to the preceding VGM-specific group, while the reverse interaction is not permitted. The remaining expert connections and training procedure are unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: VGM 和 AE 通过独立的项目符读取它们对应的标记组。 在因果 VLM 掩码下，AE 专属的意图标记可以关注前文的 VGM 专属标记组，而反向交互则不被允许。 其余的专家连接和训练流程保持不变。

paragraphs.en: For w/o Stage 1 Video Loss , we remove the future-video prediction objective only during Stage 1. Stage 2 restores the standard video and action objectives. This variant therefore isolates the role of video supervision in shaping Predictive Intent during Stage 1 rather than removing video modeling throughout training. For w/o AR Loss , the autoregressive branch and its objective are removed during Stage 1, while the video and continuous-action objectives remain unchanged. Stage 2 is identical to the default PINT configuration.
paragraphs.zh: 对于“无阶段 1 视频损失”（w/o Stage 1 Video Loss）的情况，我们仅在阶段 1 期间移除未来视频预测目标。 阶段 2 恢复了标准的视频和动作目标。 因此，这种变体将视频监督在阶段 1 中塑造预测意图的作用单独隔离出来，而不是在整个训练过程中移除视频建模。 对于“无 AR 损失”（w/o AR Loss）的情况，自回归分支及其目标在阶段 1 期间被移除，而视频和连续动作目标保持不变。 阶段 2 与默认 PINT 配置完全相同。

paragraphs.en: Stage 1 Only directly evaluates the final Stage 1 checkpoint without performing Stage 2. Inference remains identical to default PINT: the VLM first produces Predictive Intent, the VGM performs a single current-frame forward pass to produce cached layer-wise K/V features, and the AE generates the action chunk with 10 denoising steps.

paragraphs.en: Single-Stage Training jointly optimizes the VLM, Intent Tokens, VGM DiT, AE, and both Intent projectors from initialization, while keeping the video VAE frozen. It uses the autoregressive, video, and action objectives throughout training. On RoboTwin 2.0, it is trained for 10 epochs, matching the total 5 + 5 5+5 epoch budget of the default two-stage schedule. The VLM and Intent Tokens use a learning rate of 10 − 5 → 10 − 6 10^{-5}\rightarrow 10^{-6} , while the VGM, AE, and both Intent projectors use 10 − 4 → 10 − 6 10^{-4}\rightarrow 10^{-6} . Its inference procedure remains the default current-frame PINT configuration.

paragraphs.en: RoboTwin 2.0 [ 12 ] is a bimanual manipulation benchmark built around the Aloha-AgileX dual-arm robot. We jointly train a single PINT model on all 50 tasks using 50 official clean demonstrations per task, resulting in 2,500 demonstrations. The tasks cover object interaction, tool use, stacking, handover, lifting, and coordinated dual-arm manipulation.
paragraphs.zh: RoboTwin 2.0 [ 12 ] 是一个基于 Aloha-AgileX 双臂机器人构建的双手操作基准测试。 我们使用每个任务 50 个官方干净演示，在所有 50 个任务上联合训练一个单一的 PINT 模型，最终得到 2,500 个演示。 这些任务涵盖了物体交互、工具使用、堆叠、交接、提升以及双臂协同操作。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the final checkpoint on all 50 tasks under both Easy and Hard. Each evaluation uses 100 rollouts per task and setting with the official simulator success signal. The same checkpoint trained on clean demonstrations is directly evaluated under both settings without additional adaptation. Easy corresponds to the clean ID environment, whereas Hard follows the clean-to-randomized protocol and introduces domain randomization in background appearance, table clutter, lighting, and table height. Table 8 summarizes the configuration differences.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在“简单”和“困难”两种设置下，使用所有 50 个任务对最终检查点进行评估。 每次评估中，每个任务和每种设置均使用 100 次展开，并采用官方模拟器的成功信号。 在干净演示数据上训练的同一检查点，无需额外调整，即可直接在两种设置下进行评估。 “简单”模式对应干净的 ID 环境，而“困难”模式则遵循从干净到随机化的协议，并在背景外观、桌面杂乱、光照和桌面高度方面引入领域随机化。 表 8 总结了配置差异。

paragraphs.en: For LIBERO [ 50 ] , we jointly train a single model on Spatial, Object, Goal, and Long using 50 demonstrations per task. These suites respectively evaluate spatial reasoning, object-centric manipulation, goal-conditioned behaviors, and long-horizon task execution. We evaluate the final checkpoint on all four suites, conducting 50 rollouts per task with the official initial states, reset procedure, and success signal.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 LIBERO [ 50 ]，我们在 Spatial、Object、Goal 和 Long 数据集上联合训练一个单一模型，每个任务使用 50 次演示。 这些测试套件分别评估空间推理能力、以物体为中心的操控能力、目标驱动的行为以及长时域任务执行能力。 我们在所有四个测试套件上评估最终检查点，每个任务使用官方初始状态、重置流程和成功信号进行 50 次运行。

sents.en: For LIBERO [ 50 ] , we jointly train a single model on Spatial, Object, Goal, and Long using 50 demonstrations per task.
sents.zh: 对于 LIBERO [ 50 ]，我们在 Spatial、Object、Goal 和 Long 数据集上联合训练一个单一模型，每个任务使用 50 次演示。

sents.en: These suites respectively evaluate spatial reasoning, object-centric manipulation, goal-conditioned behaviors, and long-horizon task execution.
sents.zh: 这些测试套件分别评估空间推理能力、以物体为中心的操控能力、目标驱动的行为以及长时域任务执行能力。

sents.en: We evaluate the final checkpoint on all four suites, conducting 50 rollouts per task with the official initial states, reset procedure, and success signal.
sents.zh: 我们在所有四个测试套件上评估最终检查点，每个任务使用官方初始状态、重置流程和成功信号进行 50 次运行。

paragraphs.en: We directly evaluate the same LIBERO-trained checkpoint on LIBERO-Plus [ 14 ] without additional training or adaptation. Following the official protocol, each perturbed task instance is evaluated once across seven shift categories: camera viewpoint, robot initial state, language instruction, lighting condition, background texture, sensor noise, and object layout. Success is determined using the official success signal.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在没有额外训练或调整的情况下，直接将相同的 LIBERO 训练检查点在 LIBERO-Plus [ 14 ] 上进行评估。 按照官方协议，每个经过扰动的任务实例将在七个变化类别中各评估一次：摄像头视角、机器人初始状态、语言指令、光照条件、背景纹理、传感器噪声和物体布局。 成功与否由官方的成功信号决定。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the final checkpoint under both ID and OOD conditions, with 20 rollouts per task and condition. Task success is determined using the criteria in Table 11 .

paragraphs.en: Replacing Predictive Intent with prompt conditioning reduces success by 2.1 points on LIBERO but by 16.1 points on LIBERO-Plus. At the category level, the largest degradations occur under background-texture and robot-initial-state shifts, where success decreases by 45.7 and 34.6 points relative to PINT, respectively. Removing Stage 1 future-video supervision has a substantially milder effect, reducing the overall LIBERO-Plus score by 4.3 points, with the largest drops under robot initial states (8.4 points), object layout (6.1 points), camera viewpoint (5.7 points), and lighting conditions (5.3 points). Overall, these results suggest that Predictive Intent conditioning is particularly important for robustness to substantial scene and initialization shifts, while Stage 1 future-video supervision provides additional OOD robustness overall.

paragraphs.en: We measure inference latency for Fast-WAM, PINT, and PINT-VA under the same hardware and inference configuration. All measurements are performed on a single NVIDIA A100 80GB GPU using BF16 precision and batch size 1. For each model, we first run 100 inputs for warm-up, followed by three independent timing rounds of 100 inputs each. We report the mean end-to-end latency over the resulting 300 timed runs. The measured latency covers generation of a complete 32-step action chunk with 10 action denoising steps, including the VLM forward pass for PINT and PINT-VA.

paragraphs.zh: 默认 PINT 在当前帧上执行一次 VGM 前向传播，该过程以预测意图为条件，并将所得到的逐层 K/V 特征缓存下来，供所有 AE 去噪步骤使用。 PINT-VA 还允许 AE 访问来自所有视频潜在表示的 VGM 特征，并同步对未来的视频和行动潜在表示进行去噪。

paragraphs.zh: 对于二维坐标，我们使用形状为 32 × 14 的连续真实动作片段。 每个动作维度在保留的样本中经过标准化处理，随后将片段展平，通过 PCA 降维至 50 维，并用 t-SNE 投影到二维空间。

paragraphs.en: Colors are computed independently from Predictive Intent. We take the final-layer hidden states of the 32 Intent Tokens before the expert-specific projections and mean-pool them across tokens. The resulting representation is projected to three PCA dimensions, which are mapped to the RGB channels. Each channel is independently scaled using its 1st and 99th percentiles before clipping to the valid color range.
paragraphs.zh: 颜色是独立于预测意图计算的。 我们取 32 个意图标记在专家专用投影之前的最后一层隐藏状态，并对这些标记进行均值池化。 得到的表示被投影到三个主成分分析维度上，然后映射到 RGB 通道。 每个通道都使用其第 1 和第 99 百分位数进行独立缩放，然后再裁剪到有效的颜色范围。

paragraphs.en: The Intent representations are extracted from the final Stage 1 checkpoint. Because Stage 2 freezes the VLM and Intent Tokens, the Predictive Intent representation remains fixed during subsequent expert adaptation. The highlighted regions in Fig. 4 are used only for qualitative inspection of the corresponding demonstration segments and do not represent supervised behavior labels or automatically discovered semantic clusters.
paragraphs.zh: 意图表示是从第一阶段最终检查点中提取的。 由于第二阶段冻结了 VLM 和意图标记，预测意图表示在后续专家适配过程中保持不变。 图 4 中高亮显示的区域仅用于对相应的演示片段进行定性检查，并不代表监督行为标签或自动发现的语义簇。

paragraphs.en: We provide qualitative real-world rollouts to complement the quantitative evaluation of PINT. The visualizations illustrate representative executions of the five manipulation tasks under both ID and OOD conditions. For each rollout, temporally ordered observations are shown from left to right to illustrate task progression.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提供定性的真实世界运行结果，以补充对 PINT 的定量评估。 这些可视化展示了在 ID 和 OOD 条件下五个操控任务的典型执行过程。 对于每次运行，按时间顺序排列的观察结果从左到右展示，以说明任务的进展过程。
